articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.snippet: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
articles.snippet: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.snippet: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
articles.snippet: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

articles.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
articles.snippet: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.
